text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Vivlos got injured,
I accompanied her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, Trainy, I told you I'm totally fine~.
It just hurts a tiny bit... But thanks ♪"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, let's get back to practice~.
We still have today's menu left, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: My times have been super great lately, so I wanna run while I'm on a roll, ya know?!
choice_data_list: No. If you make it worse, you'll ruin all that good progress.
If you insist, we can do a different menu.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, I can't~?
Come on, just a little bit's fine, isn't it~? Let me run~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you push yourself and make it worse, you won't be able to run for even longer.
I patiently reminded her once more that this restraint is necessary for the future.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh~... But if Trainy goes that far to say it,
I guess I really should just quietly rest.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
Time to call it a day, then.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah, since we've got some free time, maybe I'll go buy some chocolate dates from the shop in front of the station♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Come with me too, Trainie~
...Pretty please?
choice_data_list: ...I'll go buy them, so please just rest.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Tch.
Guess I've got no choice but to wait quietly~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be safe, we cut training short
and decided to have her rest quietly.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, you're such a worrywart~.
But that's okay, let's practice!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Mmmh...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Does... where you got hurt still ache?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that she was favoring her injured spot,
I immediately ran over to her.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'm sorry.
Maybe I really should have just rested...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems the injury has worsened.
We will need to reconsider our current plans.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah,
this is nothing!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Just when my times were starting to improve, too...
If I don't move for days, I'll get rusty."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I can keep going! ♪
I can't afford to stop here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, I continued adjusting Vilside's training
while utilizing low-strain routines.
